QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Surana's Whereabouts
QuestInfo.0: Eremos can tell you where the next training location is.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos is distraught over Surana's departure. He recommends you travel to Fantasy Theme World, but his mind seems far away. Is he just shuffling papers back and forth to pass the time? Head to Fantasy Theme World and hunt 400 of each type of monster.
QuestInfo.2: Eremos still doesn't know where Surana is. He's putting on a brave face, but you detect an undercurrent of anxiety in his behavior. Is that, perhaps, worry?
